items.html: And another time I heard that there are three kinds of vessels in ZA, and there is one HaVaYaH in each and every Sefira of the ten Sefirot of ZA, and the four letters of this HaVaYaH become Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, and Neshama of Neshama, for the three aspects of the vessels of ZA. And we must explain all these various discourses, as you will see them scattered and explained in the composition of this book, each one in its place; and we will explain them all here in short, and we will not need to return and explain each and every one in its place.
